messages:
dmitri: Quick heads-up 1: starting a focused access sweep on cross-account KMS grants. Audit showed a spike of stale grants for dev/staging aliases.
ellie: Good call. Any sample log to reference?
dmitri: CloudTrail sample: `2026-02-12T14:03:22Z AWSKMS RevokeGrant AuthPrincipal=arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/dev-operator GrantId=abcd-1234 IssuedBy=svc-ci@example.com`. Noise mainly on alias/dev-* and alias/staging-*.
maria: I can run a list-grants and filter for grantees not in the owner map and older than 30d.
ops-bot: Alert: kms-binding-noise x5 on dev keys in 72h. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/alerts/kms-noise
maria: Found 8 grants on alias/dev-access for principals that map to deleted cross-account roles, plus 3 grants for staging CI users that rotated. Recommendation: canary revoke 1-2 stale grants on dev, run CI smoke, then batch revoke.
dmitri: Revoke process and safety steps?
maria: Steps: (1) aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/dev-access --query 'Grants[*].{id:GrantId,principal:GranteePrincipal}' (2) aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/dev-access --grant-id <grant-id>. We'll record grant params to recreate if needed.
ellie: Also tag keys with audit-retention=90d and update runbook.
security-bot: SEC-1248 created for this pulse.
maria: Took ownership. Doing canary revoke from bastion with infra-admin. ETA 45m.
dmitri: If anything breaks, recreate grant from audit log. Keep paging. :thumbsup:
maria: Canary revoke complete (2 grants). Smoke-run green. Scheduling batched revokes spaced 5m.
ops-bot: Canary smoke OK, no high-sev alerts in 10m.
dmitri: Please append removed GrantIds to SEC-1248 and mark done once finished.
maria: Will add runbook snippet and a detection query for cross-account principals without owners.
ellie: Thanks all :party:
